name: impeccable
description: Design and refine interfaces with Impeccable skills, specialist agents, and design checks.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, se

subagents.name: impeccable-asset-producer
subagents.description: Produces clean reusable raster assets from approved Impeccable mock references without redesigning the direction.

subagents.name: impeccable-documenter
subagents.description: Records DESIGN.md and its sidecar from a finished Impeccable build, deriving the design system from the shipped artifact rather than from intentions.

subagents.name: impeccable-finish-reviewer
subagents.description: Reviews a finished Impeccable build against its direction contract, the approved comp, and the chosen world's quality bar, returning an ordered list of material fixes.

subagents.name: impeccable-manual-edit-applier
subagents.description: Applies leased Impeccable live manual copy-edit batches to source and returns canonical Apply results.
